extraction.Name: Philomena Beauvais (Leighton)
extraction.NOTES: Document dated June 28, 1929, from Rosebud, South Dakota, written by Superintendent E. E. McKean. References Circular 2464 report on 'forced patents.' Affidavit and copy of application for fee patent were inclosed but not present in this document. A previous report had included a statement of instruments of record affecting this allotment and an application for fee patent which had not been previously submitted.
